Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:43ac6c60b8f89723f746e8a92ce91abd5017e627ce1ddfe4238355d3a30b772c
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "app.cjs"]
HEALTHCHECK CMD node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" || exit 1
